records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Orchard Logistics!
records.body:
Hi Hana,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Orchard Logistics* just joined on the pro plan!

decisions.rationale: Six days since signup with zero engagement: no reply to the welcome email [email:7082078c], no project, no invite, no tickets. Nothing in the record signals intent or a scheduled start, so unaided activation in the remaining 8 days looks unlikely, though an active Pro subscription leaves some chance.

draft.subject: Getting your first Wrenfield project started
draft.body:
Hi Hana,

Checking in since your Wrenfield welcome note last week. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so creating that first project is the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and once it's there you can invite your team from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything about how your team works day to day.

Best,
Nadia
